problems.title: A tangent addition identity
problems.question: Given tanα·tan2α·tan3α=−0.5, find tanα+tan2α−tan3α.
problems.idea: Rewrite the tangent addition formula without a fraction.
steps: Move tan3α to the other side: tanα+tan2α−tan3α=−tanα tan2α tan3α.

problems.title: A reciprocal-square trig sum
problems.question: Find 1/cos²α+1/sin²α if tan⁴α+cot⁴α=25.04.
problems.idea: Square tan²α+cot²α and use tanα cotα=1.

problems.title: A cubic solved with a triple-angle formula
problems.question: Which listed number solves 8x³−6x+1=0?
problems.idea: Compare the cubic with cos3θ=4cos³θ−3cosθ.
problems.answer: sin10°. This is the listed solution, not a claim that the cubic has only one root.

problems.title: Total versus lateral area of a hexagonal prism
problems.question: In a regular hexagonal prism the short space diagonal is √5/2 times the short base diagonal. Find total surface area divided by lateral area.
problems.idea: Use a right triangle to obtain height from base edge.
formulas: Short base diagonal=a√3; short space diagonal²=3a²+h².
steps: Lateral area=6ah=3√3a². The two bases together also have area 2·(3√3a²/2)=3√3a².
Total area is twice the lateral area.

problems.title: Count the edges from prism diagonals
problems.question: A prism has 18 space diagonals. How many edges does it have?
problems.idea: At each of the n lower vertices there are n−3 upper vertices not joined by an edge or face diagonal.
steps: Thus n=6 and the edge count is 18.

problems.title: The period of a shifted cosine
problems.question: Find the least positive period of $f(x)=3\cos(2x+\pi/3)+2$.
problems.idea: A phase or vertical shift does not change the period.

problems.title: A radical trig expression with fourth powers
problems.question: Simplify $\frac{\sin^2 2\alpha}{\sqrt{1-\cos^2\alpha(1+\sin^2\alpha)}}+\frac{\sin^2 2\alpha}{\sqrt{1-\sin^2\alpha(1+\cos^2\alpha)}}$.
problems.idea: Reduce the radicands before taking their square roots.
steps: The square roots are sin²α and cos²α, both nonnegative. The denominators require sinα cosα≠0.

problems.title: Apply a double-angle identity twice
problems.question: Evaluate $\cot x-\tan x-2\tan2x$ at $x=\pi/16$.
problems.idea: Use cot t−tan t=2cot2t.

problems.title: Lateral area from diagonal sections
problems.question: A right parallelepiped has a rhombus base. Its diagonal-section areas are 12 and 16. Find its lateral area.
problems.idea: The half-diagonals and a rhombus side form a right triangle.
formulas: If base diagonals p,q and height h, section areas=ph,qh; side=√(p²+q²)/2.

problems.title: The smallest angle between square-prism diagonals
problems.question: A regular square prism has height √2 times its base edge. Find the smallest angle between its space diagonals.
problems.idea: Compare direction vectors of two different types of diagonal pairs.
formulas: For edge a and height h=a√2, each diagonal has squared length 4a².
steps: Directions (a,a,h) and (a,−a,h) have dot product h²=2a², so their angle has cosine 1/2 and is 60°.
Directions (a,a,h) and (−a,−a,h) have dot product h²−2a²=0 and angle 90°.

problems.title: Which translated coordinate systems can show a cosine graph?
problems.question: The graph y=cos x is viewed after the coordinate axes are translated parallel to themselves. Which listed functions can describe it?
problems.idea: A translation permits both a horizontal phase change and a vertical shift.
formulas: The new equation has form y=cos(x+h)+v.
steps: y=cos x+1 is possible with h=0,v=1.
y=sin x is possible with h=−π/2,v=0.
y=π/2−sin x is possible with h=π/2,v=π/2.
y=1−cos x is possible with h=π,v=1. The alternatives cos2x and tan x cannot arise from translation.
problems.answer: Four listed possibilities: cos x+1, sin x, π/2−sin x, and 1−cos x.
problems.note: With unrestricted parallel translation, several answers are valid. A specified translation is needed for a single-choice answer.

problems.title: The square-root sign in a half-angle identity
problems.question: Which listed equality is not an identity?
problems.idea: An even square root returns an absolute value.
steps: It equals cosα only when cosα≥0.
For α=π the left side is 1 and the claimed right side −1.
problems.answer: The claimed identity √[(1+cos2α)/2]=cosα is false in general.

problems.title: Classify a triangle from sine-proportional sides
problems.question: A triangle has sides $\sin(\pi/14)$, $\sin(5\pi/14)$, $\sin(4\pi/7)$. Classify it.
problems.idea: These are the sine-rule side ratios of a triangle with angles summing to π.
steps: The corresponding triangle has angles π/14,5π/14,4π/7 and exactly these side ratios, up to scale.

problems.title: An angle between two hexagonal-prism diagonals
problems.question: All edges of regular hexagonal prism ABCDEFA₁B₁C₁D₁E₁F₁ are equal. Find cos of the angle between A₁E and A₁D.
problems.idea: Use coordinates with edge length 1.

problems.title: Direction cosines of a box diagonal
problems.question: A rectangular box diagonal makes angles α,β,γ with its three edge directions. Given cosα=12/13 and cosβ=4/13, find cosγ.
problems.idea: The squared direction cosines sum to 1.
steps: These are angles to the positive-length edges, so the cosine is positive.

problems.title: A cosine cannot equal this floor
problems.question: How many real solutions does cos x=⌊x⌋ have?
problems.idea: The integer on the right must lie between −1 and 1.
steps: If ⌊x⌋=0 then 0≤x<1, where cos x>0 and is not zero.
If ⌊x⌋=1 then 1≤x<2, where cos x<1. None works.

problems.title: A difference of square roots
problems.question: Evaluate √(1+sin20°)−√(1−sin20°).
problems.idea: Recognize squares using the half-angle 10°.
steps: Both cos10°+sin10° and cos10°−sin10° are positive.
Taking square roots and subtracting leaves 2sin10°.

problems.title: An absolute double-angle sine
problems.question: Find |sin2α| if cos(α/2)=−3/5.
problems.idea: Use a half-angle identity, then the Pythagorean identity.

problems.title: Projection lengths in a parallelepiped
problems.question: B₁ is equidistant from all lower-base vertices of a parallelepiped, and D is equidistant from all upper-base vertices. Find the ratio of the base projections of BD₁ and DB₁.
problems.idea: The bases are rectangles, and the projection of B₁ is the lower-base centre.
formulas: Take B as 0, D as vector v; the base centre is v/2 and the horizontal translation to the upper base is v/2.
steps: Thus the projection of B₁ is v/2, while that of D₁ is v+v/2=3v/2.
The BD₁ projection has length 3|v|/2. The DB₁ projection has length |v|/2.

problems.title: A diagonal perpendicular to a rhombus base
problems.question: A parallelepiped has rhombus base ABCD. DB₁ is perpendicular to the base and half the length of a lateral edge. Find area(A₁ACC₁)/area(ABCD).
problems.idea: Write the lateral edge as its horizontal and vertical components.
formulas: Let base diagonals p=AC,q=BD, height h=DB₁, lateral edge L=2h. Then L²=q²+h².
steps: The AC diagonal is perpendicular to both BD and the vertical direction; hence AC is perpendicular to the lateral edge.
The section area is pL and the base area pq/2. Their ratio is 2L/q.

problems.title: Cancel complementary-angle factors
problems.question: Evaluate 2cos63°cos27°sin36°/(cos54°cos36°).
problems.idea: Use complements and a double angle.
steps: Numerator and denominator both reduce to cos36°sin36°.

problems.title: A radical expression becomes a sine
problems.question: Evaluate 4cos²40°−√(4sin⁴10°+sin²20°).
problems.idea: Factor the radicand and use a double-angle identity.

problems.title: Factor a sum of four cosines
problems.question: Simplify $(1+\cos2\alpha+\cos6\alpha+\cos8\alpha)/(\cos\alpha\cos3\alpha\cos4\alpha)$.
problems.idea: Pair the outer and inner angles.
steps: Cancel the nonzero original denominator factors.

problems.title: Find a prism edge from a face diagonal
problems.question: A regular hexagonal prism has lateral area 72 and a lateral-face diagonal 5. Find its base edge a, knowing a is less than its height.
problems.idea: The lateral faces are rectangles with sides a,h.
steps: Since a<h, the base edge is 3.

problems.title: Height above a tangential trapezoid
problems.question: A right prism has a tangential trapezoid base with midline 4. The lateral surface area is 48. Find the prism height.
problems.idea: Opposite side sums of a tangential quadrilateral agree.
formulas: Base sum=2·midline=8; leg sum=8; perimeter=16; lateral area=perimeter×height.
